notes.title: We have been crowdfunded!
notes.notes:
Our crowdfunding has been succeeded and we hit almost 200% of our goal.
We really appreciate every backer that believed in our project and made this journey possible! We wouldn't make it without you guys.

We also would like to thank every single one that shared our campaign and helped us spread the word.
We truly hope you guys enjoy the game!

And we'd like to add a note: this game isn't only about loneliness and how harsh it can be, it's also about hope and overcoming ourselves. It's about finding a will to live, even in the tiny of things, making day-by-day choices. We'd like to show that every minor step matters - even if it's just about opening a curtain in your bedroom.
You don't have to go through depression alone, seek help and you'll see how big and meaningful you are!
